name: Maintenance of Govt Boys and Girls Hostels (SC)
benefit: - Free Accommodation in Government Hostels. - Free Meals (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner). - Free Educational Facilities such as textbooks and study material.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have passed class 10th (SSC) or higher from GSEB/CBSE.1. The applicant must be enrolled in a regular course in a college within the same district as the hostel. 1. The boy student's annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000. No income limit for girl students. 1. The applicant must have scored at least 50% marks in the last annual exam.
